verdict.rationale: Foreloop has no native scheduler. Its docs say the CLI can be driven 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.' Stable --json output, meaningful exit codes and FORELOOP_TOKEN auth make unattended runs from external cron or CI practical. Recurring scheduling therefore depends on an outside tool. Missing for 10: built-in recurring job or workflow scheduling, schedule management (create, list, pause), run history or monitoring of scheduled jobs, and any hands-on corroboration.
